newsitem.title: INDIA: India to release 100,000 t wheat for domestic sale.
newsitem.headline: India to release 100,000 t wheat for domestic sale.

text.p: India's grain procurement agency said on Tuesday that it will release an additional 100,000 tonnes of wheat for domestic sales in November to check rising prices.
The state-owned Food Corporation of India (FCI) said in a statement that the fresh allotment of 100,000 tonnes would raise the total amount of wheat to be released this month to 499,000 tonnes.
Earlier, the FCI had said it would release 399,000 tonnes of wheat for open sales in November.
FCI said it had been authorised by the government to intervene in the market to "reverse the inflationary trends in the price of wheat".
